applies_to: future Stage-C target-SLM release candidates only

rationale.margin_rule: The practical margin is rounded upward from the observed paired MDE95 range and must be frozen before a future candidate is evaluated.
rationale.current_candidate_status: The existing frozen confirmatory result remains confirmatory_joint_not_supported.

confirmatory_requirements.target_mean_confidence_rule: one-sided 95% training-seed-level lower confidence bound must exceed zero
confirmatory_requirements.external_retention_rule: candidate external-retention NLL must not exceed base no-update for every fresh seed
confirmatory_requirements.task_rule: predeclared task aggregate must improve or remain within a frozen non-inferiority margin

forbidden_uses: retroactively changing an existing frozen confirmatory decision
using Utility or target-model outcomes in the Stage-B selector objective
selecting a candidate on confirmatory holdouts
claiming release readiness without task-based evidence
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: Protocol definition only; it does not certify the current candidate.
